title: SYNTHETIC Meridian Works Security Questionnaire
purpose: Demonstration input for the PayProof Risk and Compliance Track.

questions.question: Is multi-factor authentication (MFA) enabled for every identity?
Is customer data encrypted at rest?
Are backups performed on the required schedule and currently succeeding?
Are vulnerability scans conducted and are high-severity findings assigned for remediation?
Who has access to production, including service and emergency accounts?
Does employee and contractor offboarding remove access within the required timeframe?
